title: Delete or reconnect the superseded Sefaria-REST fetcher pipeline (curriculum_content_fetcher.dart + its 989-line test suite)
rule: Everything sweep: dead code; AG-1 (no ad-hoc variants outside make targets); Fowler speculative generality

evidence.quote: Docker. There are **no public Sefaria API calls** in the build path.

why: CurriculumContentFetcher/FetchResult/SefariaApiException (curriculum_content_fetcher.dart) have zero implementations or callers anywhere in lib/ — their only implementers are the 7 tool/lib/sefaria/*_fetcher.dart classes, and their only caller is tool/seed_content.dart, which is not invoked by `make seed` (Makefile) or any current doc workflow. docs/seed-build.md states in writing that the canonical pipeline (tool/seed/build_text_cache.dart) replaced 'the old dependency on ... the public Sefaria API' and makes 'no public Sefaria API calls'. Worse, dio_client_test.dart (158 lines) and fetcher_test.dart (831 lines) — 989 of my batch's 1188 lines — thoroughly test createDioClient/createSefariaClient/RetryInterceptor and the 7 fetchers, none of which the live pipeline calls: seed_content.dart builds its own untested, retry-less, logger-less Dio() inline (line 26) instead of reusing the fully-tested createSefariaClient(). This is a large, continuously-CI-run, thoroughly-documented dead branch that will mislead a future contributor fixing a Sefaria-shape regression into 'fixing' code nothing runs, while docs/explainers/content-database.md and docs/source-tree-analysis.md still list seed_content.dart as if it's live, contradicting docs/seed-build.md.
recommendation: Either (a) delete curriculum_content_fetcher.dart, tool/lib/sefaria/*_fetcher.dart, tool/lib/dio_client.dart, tool/seed_content.dart and their two test files, and update docs/explainers/content-database.md + docs/source-tree-analysis.md to drop seed_content.dart from the tree/diagram; or (b) if intentionally kept as a manual fallback, wire tool/seed_content.dart to call createSefariaClient() (so the tested retry/redaction logic is actually exercised) and add a doc note stating its fallback status.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn 'CurriculumContentFetcher\|createSefariaClient\|createDioClient' across lib/ and tool/ shows either zero results (deleted) or a real caller in tool/seed_content.dart (reconnected)
docs/explainers/content-database.md and docs/source-tree-analysis.md source-tree listings match what actually exists post-fix
`make seed` (or its documented fallback) is the only content-build path referenced by both code and docs
